preconditions.description: The number of fish caught by Alice must be between 1 and 100,000.
The number of fish caught by Bob must be between 1 and 100,000.
The number of fish species must be between 1 and 1,000,000,000.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= a <= k for a in alice_fish)
preconditions.description: All fish types caught by Alice must be valid species numbers.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= b <= k for b in bob_fish)
preconditions.description: All fish types caught by Bob must be valid species numbers.

postconditions.expression: stdout == 'YES' if sum(w[i] for i in alice_fish) > sum(w[i] for i in bob_fish) else 'NO'
postconditions.description: Output 'YES' if the total weight of Alice's fish is strictly greater than Bob's, otherwise output 'NO'.
